query: Let `M` be an `R`-module, `n : ℕ`, and `v : I → M` an indexed family with `I` linearly ordered. If the range of `v` spans `M`, then the family `(v(i₁) ∧ ⋯ ∧ v(iₙ))` indexed by ordered subsets `{i₁ < ⋯ < iₙ} ⊆ I` of size `n` spans the `n`th exterior power `⋀ⁿ M ⊆ ⋀M` (viewed as a submodule of the exterior algebra).

    12  # Exterior powers
    13  
    14  We study the exterior powers of a module `M` over a commutative ring `R`.
    15  
    16  ## Definitions
    17  
    18  * `exteriorPower.ιMulti` is the canonical alternating map on `M` with values in `⋀[R]^n M`.
    19  
    20  * `exteriorPower.presentation R n M` is the standard presentation of the `R`-module `⋀[R]^n M`.
    21

    24    `Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/ExteriorPower.lean` for the corresponding functor
    25    `ModuleCat R ⥤ ModuleCat R`.)
    26  
    27  ## Theorems
    28  * `exteriorPower.ιMulti_span`: The image of `exteriorPower.ιMulti` spans `⋀[R]^n M`.
    29  
    30  * We construct `exteriorPower.alternatingMapLinearEquiv` which
    31    expresses the universal property of the exterior power as a
    32    linear equivalence `(M [⋀^Fin n]→ₗ[R] N) ≃ₗ[R] ⋀[R]^n M →ₗ[R] N` between
    33    alternating maps and linear maps from the exterior power.
